abilities.name: Outlander Arts: Vigilant Watch

sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

abilities.note:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

passives.name: Battlelines Redrawn
passives.note: When the Manekin leaves the field, if a Restricted Area that they summoned is still active, it will explode, dealing AoE DMG of the Manekin's Elemental Type equal to 200% of the Manekin's ATK.

passives.name: Combat Readiness
passives.note: When the Manekin is not on the field and their Elemental Energy is below 30%, they will recover 2 Elemental Energy per second.
